basic_details.short_information: Sainik School Amaravathinagar (Sainik School Amaravathinagar), under the Sainik Schools Society, Ministry of Defence, Government of India, has released the Sainik School Amaravathinagar Recruitment 2026 Notification on its official website. A total of 8 vacancies have been announced for PGT Maths, PGT English, PGT Physics, TGT Maths, Laboratory Assistant (Physics), Counselor, Band Master, and Art Master posts under regular and contractual appointments.

application_fee.details: The fee must be paid online through "SBI Collect" using the link provided on the Sainik School Amaravathinagar website under "Online Fee option for Recruitment." After payment, candidates must take a print of the receipt and attach it with the application, and also enter the payment details in the prescribed format attached with the application form. No refund will be made to rejected applicants.

salary_details.tgt - maths: Rs. 44,900/- + DA per month (Level-7, Index-1 in Pay Matrix, as per 7th CPC)

salary_details.details: Regular staff are entitled to DA, Transport Allowance, LTC, Contributory Pension as per NPS, subsidised schooling for two children, Death-cum-Retirement Gratuity, and Leave Encashment, as admissible under Sainik Schools Society Rules and Regulations. Appointment is made with an All India transferability clause. Rent-free accommodation is available in the school campus for all posts (Regular and Contractual). Free messing for self with cadets during the academic session is provided for all posts. | The contractual post will be for a maximum period of 3 years; the total contract duration will not, under any circumstances, exceed 3 years from the date of appointment. On completion of 11 months from the date of joining, the contract may be extended by one year based on performance review and institutional requirement. The contract includes a one-month break every year (after 11 months of service); during school vacation/break, if the contractual staff member is not on active duty, no remuneration is paid. The contract period can be curtailed by the school due to administrative/policy reasons, and the school is not liable to pay any compensation in case of curtailment. After completion of the 3-year contract, a fresh recruitment process would be conducted.

selection_process: The selection process consists of three phases
along with weightage for higher qualification and experience.
A candidate must score a minimum of 33% marks to qualify for the next step (skill/trade test). However
the Board of Officers may increase this minimum qualifying mark up to 50% to shortlist candidates for the next stage of selection.

Shortlisted candidates will be required to demonstrate their classroom teaching skills in a live classroom environment on a topic assigned by the Selection Board. The demonstration must be supported by a well-prepared lesson plan and appropriate teaching aids.
Candidates will appear before the Selection Board for an interview to assess subject knowledge
and overall suitability for the post. The topics and areas of assessment will be determined by the Board.
The selection process will tentatively be conducted in the third week of September 2026 at Sainik School
how_to_apply: Applications must be filled through Google Forms; the link is available on the school website, www.sainikschoolamaravathinagar.edu.in.

In addition, candidates must apply on the prescribed application format available for download on the same website, and forward the completed form to: "The Principal, Sainik School, Amaravathinagar, Pin - 642 102, Udumalpet Taluk, Tiruppur District (Tamil Nadu)."
Enclose the recent photograph, self-attested mark sheets/certificates, fee-paid proforma, and (where applicable) the caste category certificate with the application.
Superscribe the envelope with the name of the post applied for, in BOLD letters.
Ensure the complete hard copy application, along with all required enclosures, reaches the Principal by the last date, 25 August 2026.
important_instructions: Applications will be considered only upon receipt of the duly completed hard copy of the application form along with all requisite supporting documents. Submission of the Google Form and payment of the application fee through SBI Collect alone shall not constitute a valid application. Applications for which hard copies and supporting documents are not received by the prescribed date will be summarily rejected and will not be considered for the selection process under any circumstances. Applications received late (including postal delay), without deposit of the application fee, or not in the prescribed application form format available on the school website, will be summarily rejected without any intimation. No correspondence will be entertained. By hand or e-mail applications will not be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria based on essential qualifications will be called for the selection process. Details will be notified on the school website. Call letters will be sent only through e-mail; no hard copy admit card will be sent. Candidates must mention their valid, functional e-mail ID, correspondence address, mobile number, and alternate mobile number clearly and legibly in the application form. The school will not be responsible for failure of communication due to illegible details. No TA/DA will be admissible for attending the selection process. Candidates must make their own arrangements for boarding and lodging. Sainik School, Amaravathinagar, is not a State Government or Central Government Department/Institution; employment conditions and service rules are in consonance with the Sainik Schools Society Rules and Regulations, as amended from time to time. Selected candidates should be ready to accept additional responsibilities usual to a residential public school, or as delegated by the Principal. The school administration reserves the right to increase, decrease, or cancel all or any vacancy due to non-availability of suitable candidates or administrative/policy reasons, without assigning any reason. No formal intimation will be given to applicants. Selection of candidates will be carried out purely on a merit basis. Candidates should visit the school website regularly for the latest updates on this recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Sainik School Amaravathinagar Salary Structure 2026
content_sections.text: Regular staff are entitled to DA, Transport Allowance, LTC, Contributory Pension as per NPS, subsidised schooling for two children, Death-cum-Retirement Gratuity, and Leave Encashment, as admissible under Sainik Schools Society Rules and Regulations. Appointment is made with an All India transferability clause. Rent-free accommodation is available in the school campus for all posts (Regular and Contractual). Free messing for self with cadets during the academic session is provided for all posts. The contractual post will be for a maximum period of 3 years; the total contract duration will not, under any circumstances, exceed 3 years from the date of appointment. On completion of 11 months from the date of joining, the contract may be extended by one year based on performance review and institutional requirement. The contract includes a one-month break every year (after 11 months of service); during school vacation/break, if the contractual staff member is not on active duty, no remuneration is paid. The contract period can be curtailed by the school due to administrative/policy reasons, and the school is not liable to pay any compensation in case of curtailment. After completion of the 3-year contract, a fresh recruitment process would be conducted.

content_sections.heading: Sainik School Amaravathinagar Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of three phases, along with weightage for higher qualification and experience. A candidate must score a minimum of 33% marks to qualify for the next step (skill/trade test). However, the Board of Officers may increase this minimum qualifying mark up to 50% to shortlist candidates for the next stage of selection. Shortlisted candidates will be required to demonstrate their classroom teaching skills in a live classroom environment on a topic assigned by the Selection Board. The demonstration must be supported by a well-prepared lesson plan and appropriate teaching aids. Candidates will appear before the Selection Board for an interview to assess subject knowledge, teaching aptitude, communication skills, and overall suitability for the post. The topics and areas of assessment will be determined by the Board. The selection process will tentatively be conducted in the third week of September 2026 at Sainik School, Amaravathinagar, Udumalpet Taluk, Tiruppur District (Tamil Nadu).
